content.title: Xylo Technologies says Viewbix shares to begin trading on Nasdaq
content.summary: Xylo Technologies (XYLO) announced that Viewbix (VBIX) has received approval for its shares of common stock to be listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market. Viewbix, in which Xylo holds an indirect stake through its 45.74% ownership in Gix Internet, which in turn owns 2,818,585 common shares representing 42.58% of Viewbix, expects its shares to commence trading on Nasdaq under the symbol “VBIX” on or about June 5, 2025, subject to continued compliance with Nasdaq exchange rules.
